details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2969-3025 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: The dedupe branch can reuse an existing fix-up and post the tracking comment before the tracker-open guard runs, so a closed tracker still gets updated.
  WHY: All reviewers said the reuse path runs before the closed-tracker check, so comments and `ai:validation-fixing` labels can be applied to a tracker that is no longer open.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2985-2988 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: The jq dedupe filter calls `contains($lid)` on `.body` without null handling, so a null body can make the dedupe check fail.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on severity (medium vs critical), but all said null issue bodies make `contains()` error and the fallback leaves dedupe empty.
- tests/test_validate_process.py:105-108, 135-165, 562, 638, 770, 870 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: `mock_gh` reads `issue_list_response` and `api_responses` from `globals()`, but the tests set those names on `mock_env`.
  WHY: The reviewer said the mocked responses never reach the scope that `mock_gh` reads, so the test harness cannot simulate API responses as intended.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2985-2988 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `contains($lid)` dedupe check is too loose and can match the wrong Local ID.
  WHY: All reviewers described substring matching as a false-positive risk on similar body text.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2980-2983 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: The 200-item `gh issue list` cap can miss additional open orchestrator-managed issues.
  WHY: Reviewers said repositories with more than 200 matching issues can hide duplicates from the dedupe pass.
- tests/test_validate_process_fixup_labels.py:340-538 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: There is no test for the dedupe-hit plus closed-tracker overlap.
  WHY: Both reviewers said the current cases do not validate that the tracker-open guard wins in that scenario.
- README.md:1384 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The inline code span around `Local ID` uses double backticks and renders awkwardly.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on severity (low vs medium), but both said the Markdown formatting is non-standard.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2981-3011 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: Redirecting stderr to `/dev/null` on the GitHub calls hides API failures.
  WHY: Both reviewers said the suppression makes failures harder to debug.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2994 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `CREATED_FIX_ISSUES_JSON` is misleading because it also stores reused issue numbers from dedupe.
  WHY: Both reviewers said the name implies new issues only, but the variable includes reused ones too.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2969-3020 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Dedupe logic runs before tracker-open guard, allowing comments and labels to be posted on closed trackers
  WHY: If a tracker is closed but a matching fix-up issue exists, the system will post a comment and set ai:validation-fixing label on the closed tracker, violating the "never open a fix-up against a closed tracker" rule
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2985 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: jq filter doesn't handle null body values
  WHY: If any issue in the list has a null body, contains() will fail with "null and string cannot have their containment checked" error, causing dedupe to fail even when a match exists
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2985 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: contains($lid) substring matching can produce false positives
  WHY: Looking for "Local ID: `validation-fix-cycle-2`" could match "Local ID: `validation-fix-cycle-20`" or "Local ID: `validation-fix-cycle-2-suffix`"
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2983 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: --limit 200 may miss duplicates in repositories with >200 open ai:orchestrator-managed issues
  WHY: In active repositories with many orchestrator-managed issues, duplicates beyond the first 200 won't be detected
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2985, 3011 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Stderr redirected to /dev/null hides API failures
  WHY: Debugging API issues becomes harder when error output is suppressed
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2994 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: CREATED_FIX_ISSUES_JSON variable name is misleading
  WHY: Variable contains reused issue numbers, not just created ones, which could confuse maintainers reading the code
- tests/test_validate_process_fixup_labels.py:538 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Missing test for overlapping condition (dedupe match AND tracker closed)
  WHY: No test validates that the tracker-open guard takes priority over dedupe logic
- README.md:1384 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: Awkward code span formatting with double backticks
  WHY: Renders poorly in documentation
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/validate_process. sh:29,972-30,011 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The dedupe check runs FIRST. When a matching open fix-up is found, the code posts a tracking comment and sets the `ai:validation-fixing` label BEFORE the tracker-open guard can check whether the tracking issue is closed. The dedupe path then exits before the guard runs.
  WHY: If the tracking issue is closed but an open fix-up exists, the script can comment on and relabel a closed issue before the closed-tracker check.
- scripts/validate_process. sh:29,988 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The jq filter uses `.body | contains($lid)` without null protection.
  WHY: A null body makes jq error, and the `|| true` fallback leaves the dedupe check empty.
- scripts/validate_ process.sh:29,988 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `contains($lid)` can produce false-positive dedupe matches.
  WHY: The substring check can match similar Local IDs, such as `validation-fix-cycle-2` inside `validation-fix-cycle-20`.
- scripts/validate_ process.sh:29,994 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `CREATED_FIX_ISSUES_JSON` is misleading because it also contains reused existing issue numbers.
  WHY: The variable name suggests only newly created issues, but dedupe appends reused numbers too.
- scripts/validate_ process.sh:29,981, 30,007 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Redirecting stderr to `/dev/null` hides API failures.
  WHY: Suppressed error output makes GitHub API problems harder to debug.
- scripts/validate_ process.sh:29,980 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `--limit 200` cap can miss open duplicates in repos with more than 200 `ai:orchestrator-managed` issues.
  WHY: Only the first 200 open issues are inspected, so later duplicates are skipped.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2969-3025 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The dedupe check executes before the tracker-open guard, so a matching fix-up issue can be reused and labeled even when the tracker is closed.
  WHY: The reviewer said the code posts the tracking comment and sets `ai:validation-fixing` before the closed-tracker check runs.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2988 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq filter uses `.body | contains($lid)` without null-handling.
  WHY: Null issue bodies make jq error, so dedupe is skipped and duplicates can be created.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2988 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `contains($lid)` is a loose substring match and can produce false-positive dedupe hits.
  WHY: The reviewer said cycle numbers with shared prefixes can match the wrong issue body.
- README.md:~1384 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The code span around `Local ID` uses double backticks and renders awkwardly.
  WHY: The reviewer said the Markdown formatting is non-standard and should use a single inline code span.
- tests/test_validate_process_fixup_labels.py:340-538 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: There is no test for the dedupe-hit plus closed-tracker case.
  WHY: The reviewer said the current cases cover dedupe/open, closed/no dedupe, and open/no dedupe, but not the overlap.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3-coder-plus ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2969-3020 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The dedupe path can post a tracking comment and flip `ai:validation-fixing` on a closed tracker because the tracker-open guard runs later.
  WHY: When a matching open fix-up issue exists, the code reuses it and posts the comment before discovering the tracker is closed.
- tests/test_validate_process.py:105-108, 135-165, 562, 638, 770, 870 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `mock_gh` function reads from `globals()` for `issue_list_response` and `api_responses`, but the tests set these names as attributes on `mock_env`.
  WHY: The mocked responses are never properly transferred from the test environment to the global scope that `mock_gh` accesses, causing test mocks to fail.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2988 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `contains($lid)` filter performs a loose substring match that can produce false-positive deduplication matches.
  WHY: The reviewer said the Local ID check can match an issue body that merely contains the target substring.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2988 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If any listed issue has a null body, the jq `contains()` check will error and the dedupe command fails.
  WHY: The reviewer said null issue bodies cause the filter to fail and disable dedupe.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2980 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Limiting the GitHub issue list to 200 issues can miss open duplicate fix-up issues.
  WHY: The reviewer said repositories with more than 200 orchestrator-managed issues may leave later duplicates unseen.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3-coder-plus ===
